decision: Reprimand for the driver This is the driver's 1st Reprimand of the Season (Driving) Reason The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda), the driver of Car 16 (Charles Leclerc) and team representatives, and examined video, team radio evidence. Car 22 (TSU) impeded car 16 (LEC) who was on fast lap with new tyres at turn 8, causing car 8 to abandon his lap. Driver 22 says he was pushing on an out lap for a long, high fuel run. However, the Stewards consider that a driver on an out lap must always be aware of faster cars approaching and although this did not create a dangerous situation they determine that this is a breach of the above regulation and they impose a Reprimand in this case.

fact: Impeding of Car 16 by Car 22 in Turn 8.
offence: Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
